-- Decompiled from run-only bytecode: comments and original formatting are not recoverable.

script S
	property option_down : false
end script

set r to {a:1}
set x to (a of r) + 1
set y to (get a of r) + 1
set z to "s" & a of r
if a of r = 1 then
	beep
end if
tell S
	set its option_down to 1 div 2 = 0
end tell
